qa_pairs.question: What is the memory size of the NovaBook 14?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 comes with 16 GB of memory.

contexts.text: The NovaBook 14 is a 14-inch laptop with two USB-C ports, one USB-A port, 16 GB of memory, and a 512 GB solid-state drive.

qa_pairs.question: Does the PulsePhone X include a charger in the box?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, the phone does not include a charger in the box.

contexts.text: The PulsePhone X is a dual-SIM smartphone... The phone does not include a charger in the box.

qa_pairs.question: How many days do I have to return an unopened standard device for orders placed after September 1, 2026?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.

contexts.text: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.

qa_pairs.question: How long is the warranty for the NovaBook 14?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini.

qa_pairs.question: What is the restocking fee for an opened standard device?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An opened standard device is subject to a 10% restocking fee.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if I keep a free gift from a promotional bundle when returning the main device?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A free gift that is not returned causes its stated promotional value to be deducted from the refund.

contexts.text: A free gift that is not returned causes its stated promotional value to be deducted.
If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund.

qa_pairs.question: Does the limited warranty cover accidental impact?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, the warranty excludes accidental impact.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure...

qa_pairs.question: When does warranty coverage begin for shipped orders?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders.

contexts.text: Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.

qa_pairs.question: How long does a supervisor have to review a formal service complaint?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A supervisor reviews a formal service complaint within five business days.

contexts.text: A supervisor reviews it within five business days.

qa_pairs.question: Is an opened screen protector returnable?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, opened screen protectors and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.

contexts.text: Opened ear tips, in-ear audio products, screen protectors, and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.

qa_pairs.question: Are gift cards returnable?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, gift cards are non-returnable.

contexts.text: Gift cards, digital activation codes, personalized items, and completed services are non-returnable.

qa_pairs.question: What cases can be escalated without waiting for routine support?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Safety issues, active account compromise, suspected fraud, and immediate privacy disclosure may be escalated without first waiting for routine support.

contexts.text: Safety issues, active account compromise, suspected fraud, and immediate privacy disclosure may be escalated without first waiting for routine support.

qa_pairs.question: If I bought a NovaBook 14 on August 15, 2026, what is the return window for an unopened device?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: For orders placed before September 1, 2026, Return Policy version 1.0 applies, which allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices.

contexts.text: Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices...

qa_pairs.question: Do replacement parts get a new 24-month warranty?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

contexts.text: Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

qa_pairs.question: If I have OrbitPlus and order a device on September 5, 2026, does it extend the return window for opened devices?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, OrbitPlus may extend only the unopened-device window.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus may extend only the unopened-device window as described in `03_promotions_and_membership.md`.
For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.

qa_pairs.question: How is an exchange processed for a return?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An exchange is processed as a return plus a new order; price differences, current promotions, and stock availability apply to the new order.

contexts.text: An exchange is processed as a return plus a new order; price differences, current promotions, and stock availability apply to the new order.

qa_pairs.question: I bought a third-party sensor with a wireless logo, is it automatically certified for HomeHub Mini?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, a third-party product showing the same connector or wireless logo is not automatically certified. The compatibility list is published in the OrbitLink application.

contexts.text: A third-party product showing the same connector or wireless logo is not automatically certified.

qa_pairs.question: Since the PulsePhone X has a 36-month warranty, can I get it repaired for free after 3 years?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The PulsePhone X actually has a 24-month limited hardware warranty, not 36-month. Therefore, it is not covered for free repair after 3 years.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini.
